en: I'm tired, [that's why] I'm staying home
hint: the one built on wegen, not deshalb or darum

example.target: Ich bin müde, deswegen bleibe ich zu Hause.
example.en: I'm tired, that's why I'm staying home.

trick: DES-VAY-gen ends in wegen, which means because of, so deswegen is because of that: that's why.
